tests.description: Four skipped browser acceptance journeys for the authenticated Admin-only dark outbox projection: truthful queue states, no delivery activation, recipient/content-safe display, non-Admin denial, and tenant isolation.
acceptance_criteria_covered: Authenticated Admin sees truthful queued, retry, failed, and suppressed projection states under the existing Notifications.View surface.
The pre-13.4 queue UI contains no send, activation, or delivery control and does not claim sent state.
Queue projection does not expose recipient detail, template body, Admin-only data, or raw failure detail.
Every non-Admin role is denied the queue projection.
An Admin in another tenant cannot see foreign queue rows.

fixture_needs: Extend tests/e2e/.auth/fixture.json and global setup with emailOutbox.administrator, emailOutbox.nonAdmin, and emailOutbox.otherTenantAdministrator credentials.
Seed tenant A with one harmless-reference outbox row for each queued, retry-scheduled, terminal-failed, and suppressed state, plus sanitized presentation data only.
Seed tenant B with a distinct harmless-reference queue row for the other-tenant Admin isolation journey.

Expose stable, non-PII queue-reference tokens in the Admin read model fixture; do not seed recipient addresses, template bodies, provider payloads, or real delivery credentials for browser assertions.
summary: Generated one skipped TypeScript E2E scaffold with four P0 authenticated browser journeys for Story 13.3's Admin-only, queued non-sending outbox projection. It uses the established /notifications route and introduces no navigation or delivery-control expectation.
